title: Iterator receives non-array input
problem: The Make Iterator module expects an array as input. When a non-array value (string, number, collection/object, or null) is mapped to the Iterator's Array field, the module fails or processes only one unintended bundle.
symptoms: Iterator module fails immediately on execution
Iterator processes only one bundle instead of multiple expected items
Downstream modules receive an incorrect data structure
Iterator output appears as a single string or object

likely_causes.cause: The mapped field is a JSON string representation of an array, not a parsed array
The API response contains the array nested inside a wrapper object (e.g., {data: [...]}) and the Iterator is mapped to the wrapper instead of the array
The previous module returns a Collection (object) instead of an Array
The field is null or undefined because the source module returned 0 results

diagnosis_steps: Run the scenario once and inspect the output bundle of the module feeding the Iterator
Identify whether the target field is tagged as 'Array', 'Collection', or 'Text' in the bundle inspector
If the field appears as a string, it is a JSON string — it must be parsed with parseJSON() before the Iterator
If the array is nested (e.g., response.data.items), map the Iterator to the full nested path that resolves to the array
Check whether the array can be empty at runtime — add a filter before the Iterator to skip null or empty arrays

solutions.solution: Map the Iterator's Array field to the correct nested path that contains the actual array (e.g., map 1.data.items instead of 1.data)
solutions.conditions: When the array is nested inside a wrapper object from the API response

solutions.solution: Use parseJSON() to convert a JSON string to an array before passing it to the Iterator
solutions.conditions: When the input is a string representation of an array rather than a native array

solutions.solution: Add a filter before the Iterator checking that the array field exists and is not empty, to skip execution when there are no items
solutions.conditions: When the array can be null or empty at runtime

prevention: Always inspect the exact data type (Array vs Collection vs Text) in the bundle inspector before connecting an Iterator
Add a null/empty check filter before every Iterator to handle 0-result upstream modules
Document the expected API response structure when building the scenario

title: Iterator — downstream module mapping panel shows no fields after Iterator
problem: After adding an Iterator module, the mapping panel in downstream modules shows no fields from the Iterator output, or shows only generic bundle metadata (bundle order position, bundle count). This happens because Make has not yet learned the structure of the Iterator's output items. The scenario cannot be built further until Make discovers the item structure.
symptoms: Mapping panel in modules after an Iterator shows only 'Bundle order position' and 'Total number of bundles' — no item fields
Fields from the source array items are not available for mapping in downstream modules
The scenario cannot be completed because required fields are missing from the mapping panel

likely_causes.cause: Make has not yet executed the Iterator module and has not discovered the structure of the array items — it only knows the array exists, not its item shape
The Iterator source array is mapped to a field that does not yet have a sample value in Make's module metadata

diagnosis_steps: Verify that the Iterator module is correctly connected to a module that provides an array
Click 'Run once' on the scenario to execute at least one real data pass through the Iterator
After the run completes, open the downstream module's mapping panel — Make will now show the discovered item fields
If the array is deeply nested, verify the Iterator is mapped to the innermost array path, not the parent object

solutions.solution: Execute the scenario with 'Run once' using real data. After execution, Make discovers the item structure and the mapping panel in downstream modules will show the correct fields.
solutions.conditions: Primary and recommended fix — works in all cases where the Iterator is correctly configured

solutions.solution: If 'Run once' cannot be used (no live data available), manually specify the array item structure using Make's custom JSON structure feature in the Iterator settings
solutions.conditions: When live data is unavailable and the item structure must be defined manually

prevention: Always run the scenario once with real data after adding an Iterator before mapping downstream modules
When building scenarios with Iterators, follow the pattern: connect Iterator → run once → then build downstream mappings
